notes.title: Update 0.30 - Visuals and small fixes
notes.notes:
Hi guys, happy new year!

Apologies for the long long wait for this one. 

Three things!

1. Season 2 will be ending tomorrow evening (15/01/2018) at 7PM GMT. I know it's dragged on for a long time (far longer than intended), so there will be more in the way of rewards to make up for it, with more than just skins this time.

2. This patch is the first big overhaul of the visuals and should (I hope) be immediately noticeable. There is more in the way of optimisation as well as a full rework of the lighting and rendering. There are a bunch of small fixes also included in this update, too many to mention!

3. This week will see two more updates, one bringing a much needed tutorial for newer players, and the other a brand new map.

https://i.imgur.com/mZ3tx2l.jpg

https://i.imgur.com/eQ5yb7J.jpg



Hope you like it and sorry for the wait.

Craig

notes.title: Update 0.26 - The AI Update
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Quick update today that brings a much more aggressive, fluid AI to play against.

FIXED: AI shooting through certain walls. (Note, there still might be an issue with weapons coming through walls - work in progress.)
FIXED: Backup AI moving slowly towards you without ever really reacting or taking cover.
FIXED: AI now raise the alarm after a set amount of seconds in combat.
NEW: A more aggressive AI that will work together to take you down. This AI will communicate amongst themselves in an effort to take you down.
NEW: Added text overlays for timelock buttons and the vault computers to better explain things.

Hope you like it! Please remember this is a work in progress, there may be issues with the new system and it may seem a little unbalanced at first - it's all open to fixes and balance changes.

CK

notes.title: Version 0.25 - The Train Base
notes.notes:
Hey! Long time no see. This one has been a while in the making.

Here with update 0.25 today ahead of Season 2 on Monday (15/05). Few changes as always - some new stuff, some old stuff, geometry changes on single trees etc. 

Firstly, there's a new safehouse/base. A moving safehouse/base. Go check that out!

Secondly, I've tried to improve performance by changing a few things here and there, so feedback on how it runs in this update versus previous updates would be much appreciated.

Thirdly, Season 2 will begin on Monday (15/05) with bigger and better rewards. To confirm, as was suggested by you guys, Season 2 will be judged on the overall amount of money that you've stolen throughout the season, rather than your total at the end of the season. 

Last but not least, trading cards, emoticons and backgrounds should be on their way very soon. 

Sorry for the delay and lack of communication lately, it's been a busy time. If anyone's interested, here's a fancy background (1920x1080) of the new Train base! Enjoy! 

Update should be live in 5.

notes.title: Season 1 Results & Update 0.21
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! So we're at the end of the first season and I thought I'd do a little run-through of the outcome, highs and lows and all that. A note beforehand though, this is the first season of Break_In and as such, it was never going to be the smoothest ride! The time was pushed back on the final day due to unforeseen circumstances, and I hope this didn't inconvenience anyone too much. 

So, here is how we're going to do this!

The top prize - some shiny new golden weapon skins (what else? :D) is going to be shared amongst the three players with the most money in the bank as of this moment and the 3 players who have stolen the most throughout the season in total. That means six of you guys will receive the golden weapon skins very shortly!

The second prize - some slightly less shiny, but still pretty shiny silver weapon skins will go to those finishing in the top 50 of the most wanted table at this moment. 

The "taking part" prize of some Halloween weapon skins will go to everyone who took part this season.

We'll adjust this going forward of course! Onto the awards then.

The Break_In Season 1 Awards

The hardened criminal award for most cash stolen in total, throughout the course of this season goes to...
[olist]
Dall ($5,456,294)
Xlis1 ($4,426,847)
Velth ($3,095,664)
[/olist]
Congrats guys, you got the gold!

The "I thought I'd be the only winner?!" award for most cash in the bank goes to...
[olist]
sumsar99 ($174,952)
Xlis1 ($159,444)
majoradvil ($134,686)
[/olist]
Congrats to you guys too, you've also got the gold!

The award for the top 3 most generous donors (total lost on failed raids) goes to...
[olist]
majoradvil (-$371,060)
Silverfusion (-$236,563)
Velth (-$201,325)
[/olist]
Very generous!

The "Lord Fury" award for the single biggest failed raid goes to...

Silverfusion (-$47,792)

The award for single biggest take of the season goes to...

Dall ($200,000+)

The best safehouse award (for the most cash made from player failures) goes to...

majoradvil ($408,536)

Update 0.21

That's all for this season then! I hope you guys enjoyed it, season 2 will kick off at some time in the next few days. The rewards for season 2 will be safehouse cosmetics!

- NEW: Skins feature.
- FIXED: Some AI issues.
- FIXED: Some non-exciting stuff.

Craig

notes.title: Update 0.17 - Season 1
notes.notes:
Hi guys, big update this time! Several new things added, several things to discuss, and several things to consider!

Let's start with the big one.

Season 1

Break_In will now be played out over seasons, each lasting one month. Everyone who participates during these seasons will unlock something cosmetic for the following season, with the top 50 players (the most wanted) taking something a little bit more special and exclusive. It goes without saying that the number 1 player will also get something special! I haven't yet decided on what form these rewards might take, but it will definitely be something cosmetic. Perhaps something for your safehouse, a flashy getaway car, even weapon skins? I'm very open to ideas on this, and what you'd like to see!

You can access the Most Wanted list from the main menu. It's probably a good place to find a big score too!

A side note, everyone's map has been reset to the Junkyard, and their money defaulted to $50,000. In the interest of fairness, of course :)

Return of Apartments

I was never quite happy with how the Apartments map turned out before, but it's now back in and fully converted to the grid system, featuring a massive 139 spaces to place defenses. There are also a couple of new types of defense exclusive to this map, the laser grid and the lockdown door. These defenses can be placed in any corridor space, with the lasers triggering the alarm on player contact, and the lockdown door slamming down when the alarm sounds for 60 seconds, closing your invader's escape route.

Other fixes

As always, more bugs fixed. 

- Hitboxes now accurate for backup.
- Garage door on Junkyard should now open and close for AI.
- AI can no longer see through certain vault doors.
- Fixed a camera placement on Hideout.
- Removed muzzle flash from the silenced pistol.
- Fixed alarmed windows button, you can now purchase these.
- Some other small issues.

The update should be live in 5-10 minutes all being well, I hope you guys enjoy it. Have a great weekend!

Craig

notes.title: Update 0.15
notes.notes:
Hi guys!

Update 0.15 is almost live and will kick off a week of content for Break_In culminating in an announcement on Friday evening! A quick run through of the features.

Grid

The way you place defenses on your safehouse is now customisable, you can pick what you want to put in which space. This should add a lot to the game going forward!

Note that as of tonight only Junkyard is using the grid, with the Hideout and Apartment maps to follow this week. Forest will be withdrawn for a while until I can improve it and give it some substance.

AI

The AI has been completely rewritten and are now a lot smarter. They'll no longer rush you on arrival, instead searching the place to find you and call to their allies for help. They'll also try and flank you in combat, and advance on you from cover.

UI

The first steps have been taken towards a better UI, though this is only a first iteration with a lot more to come. 

Lastly, sorry for the delay. It's been far too long but things are back on track at long last. Thank you to those of you who stuck with the game, and I hope this update improves your experience as dramatically as I think it will!

Craig

notes.title: Update 0.07a
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 

Update about to go live. Featured this time:

- Electronic panel hacking. Don't want to wait around for 2 minutes each time on a door countdown? Try finding the override panel (they can be in different places in each map) and breaking the little puzzle and all doors will come open instantly! Be careful though, you get a limited amount of moves, and failing will trigger an alarm. Once you move one piece you are committed, and backing out at this stage will also trigger an alarm.

Wouldn't want it to be too easy would we? :)

- Safe cracking. No more hit and running on people with money printers. If you have a money printer now, your cash will be kept in a safe which will require cracking. There's a detailed explanation when you try it in game and I hope you'll enjoy it!

- A new piece of music for the most recent map. Oz works his magic again.

- A few fixes around the place, a lot still to make though. Wanted to get this out there as I know a few of you found the waiting around a bit dull, so hopefully this livens things up :)

Achievements to follow next week, and a new map or two for next month.

Have a great weekend, I'll be in the group chat for a little while if anyone has questions or anything.

Thanks!

Craig

notes.title: UPDATE 0.03A
notes.notes:
Almost live... 5-10 minutes or so!

Changelog:

- New backup system

So, before there was an infinite supply of backup charging at you until you died. Now you're able to pick from one of currently two (soon to be four) security providers who will sell you additional guards. The amount you buy will be the amount that shows up when people try to attack you, in waves. The two security providers have slight differences in weapons, health, aggressiveness and response time. And one is cheaper than the other :)

- Fixed an issue where you could jump out of the map on Junkyard, again.
- Added a 1hr cooldown when targetting the same player again after a successful raid.
- Wiped the database, fresh start for everyone (sorry, was required!)
- Set Camjob as the default target for new players.
- Fixed an issue blocking the purchase of the money printer on the Forest map.
- A few small fixes here and there.

There will be another update on Friday fixing bugs, balancing equipment/weapon/defense costs, and adding a new weapon or two. Hope you like the new system, it's going to need a lot of tweaking, but hey that's why we're here right? :)

ck
